info.title: silueta — de-identification for conversation transcripts.
info.description: Command line for Silueta: de-identify a transcript against a roster you already have, so it can be analysed without the people in it, and write the manifest that says what was removed.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
silueta demo
Runs a built-in example: a transcript with the spelling damage a speech
recogniser leaves behind, and what Silueta does with it.

options.name: --context
options.description:
JSON array of { "value", "kind", "subjectId" }, the people this
record is about. Without it, only pattern rules fire.
--manifest What was removed, under which policy: keep it with the corpus.

options.name: --vault
options.description: Subject id to pseudonym. Never leaves the agency.

options.name: --lineage
options.description:
Your own word lists, labels and pattern rules, in your own
language. Without it, the lists this library ships with. Its
fingerprint goes in the manifest, so a corpus says which
lineage produced it.
